name: NZBGeek
description: Search NZBGeek for anime episodes, batches, and movies via the Newznab API.

apikey.description: Your NZBGeek API key. Find it at nzbgeek.info → Account → API Settings.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Override only if NZBGeek changes their endpoint.

category.description: Comma-separated Newznab category IDs to search. 5070 = Anime.

name: AltHub
description: Search AltHub (althub.co.za) — Newznab indexer with strong fansub coverage.

apikey.description: Your AltHub API key. Find it at althub.co.za → Profile → API.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Override only if AltHub changes their endpoint.

category.description: Comma-separated Newznab category IDs to search. 5070 = Anime.

name: AnimeTosho
description: Look up byte-matched NZBs by torrent infoHash via AnimeTosho's mirror catalog.

name: Nyaa
description: Search Nyaa.si directly via its RSS feed — anime torrents with infoHash extraction.

domain.description: Nyaa base URL. Override to use a mirror (e.g. https://nyaa.land) if nyaa.si is blocked.

category.description: Nyaa category. 1_2 = Anime English-translated, 1_3 = Non-English, 1_4 = Raw, 0_0 = All.

filter.description: Quality filter. 0 = no filter, 1 = no remakes, 2 = trusted only.

appendResolution.description: Include the requested resolution (e.g. 1080p) in the search query when available.

name: AnimeTosho (torrent)
description: AnimeTosho torrent search by AniDB EID/AID — returns .torrent links so Hayase has file metadata immediately and can fire NZB extensions even on dead torrents.

useTorrent.description: Use .torrent files (default) so file metadata is known immediately — required for the NZB pipeline to fire on dead torrents. Disable to use magnet links instead.

name: NekoBT
description: NekoBT private-tracker-style index — TVDB/TMDB/IMDB to NekoBT id via mapping JSON.

name: SeaDex
description: SeaDex curation layer (releases.moe) — community-picked best/alt anime releases by AniList id.
